request.style: English, male baritone solo with ethereal choir, harp, cello, piano, strings, majestic and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He knows how we are formed
He remembers that we are dust
Our days are like grass
Blooming like a flower
The wind passes over it
And it is gone
Its place knows it no more

[Chorus]
But the steadfast love of the LORD
Rests from everlasting to everlasting
On those who fear him
And his righteousness too
On their children's children

[Verse]
To those who keep his covenant
And remember to obey his precepts
The LORD has established his throne
In the heavens high
His kingdom rules over all
With power and light

[Chorus]
But the steadfast love of the LORD
Rests from everlasting to everlasting
On those who fear him
And his righteousness too
On their children's children

[Bridge]
Bless the LORD you his angels
You mighty ones who do his word
Obeying the voice of his word
Bless the LORD all his hosts
You his servants who do his will

[Chorus]
But the steadfast love of the LORD
Rests from everlasting to everlasting
On those who fear him
And his righteousness too
On their children's children

[Outro]
Everlasting love remains
From age to age
